description: Analyze pasted text content for AI search optimization. Performs comprehensive content quality analysis including AI slop detection, writing quality, E-E-A-T signals, data points, originality, and actionability.

content.description: The text content to analyze (markdown, plain text, or HTML)

output_format.description: Output verbosity: "detailed" (default) includes all suggestions and recommendations; "summary" provides condensed results

query.description: Optional context string describing the content topic (e.g., "sim racing equipment", "SEO guide"). Used for relevance scoring only. Defaults to "general content analysis".

name: analyze_text
